disclaimer: Synthetic starter rules for product design. Not legal, clinical, billing, or payer-specific advice.

rules.description: Date of service must fall within the authorization period.
rules.failure_message: Authorization is not active on the date of service.

rules.description: Billed CPT code must be included on the authorization.
rules.failure_message: CPT code is not listed on the authorization.

rules.description: Billed units must not exceed remaining authorized units.
Documented session time must support billed 15-minute units.
rules.failure_message: Documented time does not support billed units.

rules.description: Session note must include provider signature.
Session note should reference active treatment plan goals.
rules.failure_message: Session note does not clearly connect to active treatment plan goals.

rules.description: CPT 97153 requires documentation of direct adaptive behavior treatment.
rules.failure_message: Documentation does not clearly support direct adaptive behavior treatment.

rules.description: CPT 97155 requires protocol modification or treatment protocol assessment documentation.
rules.failure_message: Documentation does not identify protocol modification or protocol assessment.

rules.description: CPT 97155 note should include clinical rationale and data supporting the modification.
rules.failure_message: Clinical rationale or supporting data for protocol modification is missing.

rules.description: Direct therapy activities should be clearly separated from BCBA protocol modification work.
rules.failure_message: Note reads like direct treatment only and may not support 97155.
